_: The first ten minutes in the view (--opening=v2; docs/review/first-ten-minutes-plan.md). Tune here, not in code. The Hand speaks each prompt once, in the first reign only (Against the Storm's envoy; Six Ages: teach a few things).
speaker: The Hand

prompts.text: The realm is yours, Your Grace. The court is waiting.
A lord asks for you. Go to him.
Hold the realm whole to the first winter.
A house turns from you. The court will let you answer.
Winter, and the realm stands. History is watching.
